scope: Selection record for the contact-carry cue on top of the restart-dead working default. External only: Metrica Sample Games 1-3 (60 guards each), DFL J03WMX/J03WN1/J03WOH/J03WOY (development) and J03WPY/J03WQQ/J03WR9 (scored once before, never diagnosed). Challenge inputs used only for activation/debugging; no challenge labels, public-window scores, video or hand labels.
diagnosis: Most unmatched reference spells are absorbed into a longer predicted spell; the dominant separator is a missed brief opponent possession (median 1.8 s DFL, 2.3 s Metrica) during which proximity emissions favour the original team (Metrica median -5.7). An opponent within 0.75 m at a sharp observed ball turn occurs at 30% of those starts but in 0.2% of seconds inside long uninterrupted spells.
rule: Touch = observed ball for 11 frames, both 5-frame mean speeds >= 1 m/s, 1 - cos(turn) >= 0.3, touching team nearest player within 0.75 m (closer team if both). The touching team gets +0.5 emission per frame until the next touch, 2 s, or 5 frames before the ball is next unobserved, plus transition support within 2 frames of the touch.
rejected_refinement: Ending carry when the opponent gains strong control raised masked recovery accuracy slightly but lowered spell-F1 (Metrica objective 0.620/0.602/0.595 -> 0.603/0.550/0.546); reverted.

robustness.passed: 132/134 (unit tests skipped in this run; 229 unit tests pass separately)

failures.dead_share_difference_vs_reference: 0.0662 > 0.05, same disclosed prototype drift exception as restart-dead
failures.noise_0.10m frame agreement: 0.9771 < 0.98 (restart-dead 0.9880); 0.25 m passes at 0.9702 >= 0.95. Added-noise DFL scoring shows the spell-F1 gain persists.

disclosed_exceptions: Metrica recovery_masked recovery_accuracy fails in both tag modes on all three games (drop 0.018-0.043 vs 0.01 allowance); frame traces show late (~0.3 s) switches at hidden turnovers and some baseline credit from early switching; spell-F1 in the same scenario rises.
Automatic robustness noise_0.10m frame agreement 0.9771 vs 0.98.
decision: Promoted by the user as the working default with the exceptions disclosed.
